ei.title: Distress and Eustress: Two Sides of Stress

fullPassage: When you are about to go on stage or perhaps take the microphone in a work presentation, do you feel sweaty, get flushed, have a dry mouth, or taste metal? Before taking an exam, does your breathing quicken? These are signs of your body activating your stress response or sympathetic nervous system. But stress is bad, right? Actually, stress isn't always bad. In fact, there are two types of stress: distress (what we normally think of as "stress") and eustress (beneficial stress that motivates us). Coming from the same root as the word euphoria ("eu" meaning good), eustress has been shown to induce different physiological changes to distress, including less strain on your cardiovascular system and a burst of the love hormone oxytocin, which helps heal damage to your heart. Meditation techniques can channel distress into eustress to help you approach whatever challenge or task you face with a clear, calm mind that is ready to focus.

det.korean: 해로운 디스트레스와 유익한 유스트레스의 구분.
det.analysis:
✅ ② 해로운 디스트레스와 유익한 유스트레스의 구분과 활용: 글의 핵심.
❌ ① 무대 공포증을 극복하는 방법: 도입 예시.
❌ ③ 심장 건강을 지키는 호르몬 치료법: 부분적.
❌ ④ 교감 신경계의 작동 원리: 배경.

ch: 해로운 디스트레스와 유익한 유스트레스의 구분과 활용

questions.passage: When you are about to go on stage or perhaps take the microphone in a work presentation, do you feel sweaty, get flushed, have a dry mouth, or taste metal? Before taking an exam, does your breathing quicken? These are signs of your body activating your stress response or sympathetic nervous system. But stress is bad, right? Actually, stress isn't always bad. In fact, there are two types of stress: distress (what we normally think of as "stress") and eustress (____ stress that motivates us). Coming from the same root as the word euphoria ("eu" meaning good), eustress has been shown to induce different physiological changes to distress, including less strain on your cardiovascular system and a burst of the love hormone oxytocin, which helps heal damage to your heart. Meditation techniques can channel distress into eustress to help you approach whatever challenge or task you face with a clear, calm mind that is ready to focus.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? "Stress can be (A)__________ (eustress) that motivates us, and meditation can (B)__________ negative stress into this positive form."

det.korean: (A)유익한, (B)전환하다 — 유스트레스는 유익, 명상이 전환.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ beneficial — channel: 유익한 + 전환하다.
❌ ① harmful — block: 해로운 + 차단. 반대.
❌ ② temporary — create: 일시적 + 만들다. 무관.
❌ ④ beneficial — prevent: 유익 + 예방. 부적절.
